description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeaveRequestParamHelperTrait' that provides helper methods for extracting and validating leave request parameters from API requests within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for retrieving leave type ID, date ranges, comments, durations, and partial options, as well as methods for constructing LeaveParameterObject instances and validating parameter rules.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeIdParam
methods.description: Retrieves the leave type ID parameter from the request payload as an integer.

methods.name: getFromDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'from' date parameter from the request payload as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getToDateParam
methods.description: Retrieves the 'to' date parameter from the request payload as a DateTime object or null.

methods.name: getCommentParam
methods.description: Retrieves the comment parameter from the request payload as a string or null.

methods.name: getDurationParam
methods.description: Retrieves a duration array parameter from the request payload for a given key, or returns a default value.

methods.name: getPartialOptionParam
methods.description: Retrieves the partial day option parameter from the request payload as a string or null.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestParams
methods.description: Constructs a LeaveParameterObject using request parameters for a specified employee number; applies validation and sets duration options depending on the leave type.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOptions
methods.description: Sets partial day options and multi-day durations for a LeaveParameterObject based on request parameters.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for a single day leave request.

methods.name: getGeneratedDuration
methods.description: Creates a LeaveDuration object based on request parameters for duration type, start, and end times.

methods.name: getCommonParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of parameter validation rules for leave request parameters, including leave type, dates, comments, durations, and partial options.

methods.name: getEndpointLogicException
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating improper usage of the trait outside of an Endpoint context.
